source.original_title: 07/29/2026 - Alex Shivelhood x Richard Claessen DH
source.display_title: 07/29/2026 - Alex Shivelhood x Richard Claessen DH — Follow Up

call.sequence_note: Direct follow-up to 2026-07-28_alex-shivelhood_richard-claessen, the call at which the $6,000 offer was presented, the full financial picture was taken and a $100 refundable deposit was paid. The rep opens by referring to it - 'of course, we had a lovely conversation yesterday, so just curious, how did it go?' - and the purpose of this call is to hear the partner's answer. No discovery was repeated.

rep.name: Richard Claessen
rep.location: Munich, Germany for the weekend; normally Bulgaria

setter.name: Derek
setter.evidence: The DH suffix appears in this file title. On the previous day's call for the same prospect the rep said 'I already got some information from Derek', and Derek is also named as the setter on two other calls in this batch, which together resolve the DH code to a setter named Derek. Recorded as an inference.

prospect.name: Alex Shivelhood
prospect.location: Alabama, USA (Central time); travelling to visit a cousin an hour and a half away at the time of this call
prospect.occupation: Licensed insurance agent selling Medicare health plans to seniors
prospect.family_status: Lives with his partner Josh, named for the first time on this call, plus family in a recently bought house. Josh works seven days a week and cannot take calls during the day; they are saving for a cross-country holiday. They have an explicit agreement not to make financial decisions without each other.
prospect.training_background: Established on the previous call: in and out of gyms since age 13, lost 70 lb two and a half years ago with a personal trainer using nutrition and walking only, regained 50 lb after a bicycle accident, currently not training.
prospect.medical: Established on the previous call and not revisited here: bicycle accident roughly eighteen months ago with eleven broken ribs, a broken clavicle and a punctured lung; a nerve block left an abdominal wall muscle denervated and possibly permanently so; cleared for exercise by two doctors; significant post-accident depression; earlier history of drug use and homelessness.

signals: Consistent with the prior call in the same sequence - lost ground to a bicycle accident and depression, wants the 185 lb version of himself back
Desire is unambiguous and unchanged despite the answer being no: 'I literally want to do it so bad, but it's just the money'
Constraint is purely financial: $150-175 available, a credit ceiling around $1,500, near-maxed cards and a new house

Now also judges the price itself as wrong rather than merely unaffordable: 'It's way more than I thought something like that would be for six months. I personally think it's too much, but I believe in it.'

pains.text: Cannot fund the programme in any form - $150 to $175 is the absolute maximum available and his credit will not extend beyond roughly $1,500
Stretched by a new house, an outstanding storage unit and saving for a holiday, with Josh working seven days a week to fund it
Believes the price is genuinely too high for what it is, even while believing in the programme
Uncomfortable at having invested two calls before learning the cost - 'I don't like going this far and knowing, and then doing this to y'all'
Cannot make the decision alone and Josh is unreachable during working hours

objections.raw_quote: we simply just don't have enough. They don't have the money. It's way more than I thought something like that would be for six months. I personally think it's too much, but I believe in it. So my point to that is, I literally, I don't have the credit. I looked... my credit score is at a spot where I'm not going to get, you know, more than 1500 probably dollars.
objections.rep_response: Refused to let it end the conversation - 'we never want to let that be the reason' - asked what was available, tested whether $175 could be pushed to $200, and then presented the Primal University group product at $200 a month or $1,200 across six months, with a promise that payments would later be credited toward the one-to-one programme.

objections.raw_quote: I mean, my friend, I think that it's just going to have to be a no right now. Just because I don't want to add another something that we're on the, we're just on the edge with the new house and stuff.
objections.rep_response: Acknowledged and moved past it without challenge, going straight to what could be built with the money that does exist: 'We'll get to 6,000 for a second. Like, there's other things that we can look into to at least get you started.'

objections.raw_quote: I wish Josh was on the phone with me, because I just, I can't make 100% of those decisions without... we've promised each other we're not going to make these decisions without each other.
objections.rep_response: Asked whether Josh could join immediately, and when told he could not, booked a joint call for Friday at 8am Central at Josh's preferred time and asked for his name so he could address him directly.

offer.payment_plan_terms: Primal University at $200 a month across six months, totalling $1,200. The $100 deposit paid the previous day is to be applied against the first month, leaving $100 due now and the rest automatic. The rep also promised that whatever is paid would be credited toward the one-to-one programme at any later date, 'even if it takes longer than the six months'.
offer.guarantee_mentioned: No guarantee. The nearest thing was the credit promise: 'it wouldn't be lost money in that sense.'

evidence: The $6,000 offer is effectively dead: 'I think that it's just going to have to be a no right now' and 'I mean, 6,000, 6,000, no matter how you do it'
But the conversation is live on a cheaper product, and the prospect engaged with it: 'No, yeah, I mean, that makes sense'
No payment taken and no link sent on this call - the rep said 'I'll just send a link for that' but the decision was explicitly parked
Joint call booked for Friday at 8am Central with Josh present, at the rep's own initiative and Josh's preferred time
Prospect's own read was positive on the downsell: 'I think it's doable. I think it's doable. So that's just my gut reaction'
Counter-evidence: he had already used the word no once on this call, and he cannot decide without Josh, who has not yet heard any of it
outcome.cash_collection_basis: nothing_collected_on_this_call - the $100 deposit from the previous day remains held and is now earmarked against the first month of a different, cheaper product rather than refunded
outcome.next_step: Phone call on Friday at 8am Central with Alex and Josh together to close the $200-a-month Primal University tier; rep travelling to Munich but confirmed he will call

notable.note: The $6,000 died on contact with the partner and the household budget, and within ninety seconds the rep had rebuilt the deal at $200 a month. Three things a principal should see. First, the price for Primal University given here - $200 a month, $1,200 for six months - is the fourth different presentation of that product's price in eight days across this one rep's calls. Second, the rep promised that money paid into the group product would be credited toward the one-to-one programme at any future date with no time limit; no such policy appears anywhere else in the corpus. Third, the $100 deposit taken the previous day was explicitly promised as refundable if the money could not be found, that condition was met on this call, and instead of a refund being offered it was quietly applied to the first month of a different product. No discovery was run on this call, so goals were not re-elicited and the array is left empty rather than carried over.
